budget.rationale: A smoke test of the whole path on a Jetstream2 GPU VM, not a result: two requests to gpt-oss-20b served on the VM, LLM-SR's own evaluator, our conversion and refit, a development rollout and the sealed result. Run after the server starts and before any campaign, so a setup fault costs seconds rather than GPU hours.

prompt_policy.description: LLM-SR specifications natively embed a problem description, so supplying the public task specification matches its own protocol.

scope_note: Smoke test on the budget pilot's cell and seed, against the model this VM serves. Its model is never reported.
